title: A regex pattern is carried verbatim and is never anchored by the SDK.
why: behavioural spec 'regex': matching is unanchored (shape spec §4.2), so the SDK MUST NOT anchor the pattern; an author who means a full match writes '^...$'.
note: How a language spells a pattern — a string, or a compiled pattern object carrying flags the pattern text cannot hold — is the style guide's business; the entry's refusal of out-of-band flags is a per-language test, not a case here.

interaction.description: an unanchored and an anchored pattern
